nodes.name: When Called by Another Workflow
nodes.notes:
Input from WF2:
{
  conversation_id: UUID,
  lead_phone: '+5215512345678',
  lead_name: 'María García',
  property_id: 'EB-12345',
  property_title: 'Depto. Bosques de las Lomas',
  property_price: '$1,000,883 MXN',
  assigned_agent_id: 'agent_yolanda' | null
}

parameters.query:
WITH new_auction AS (
  INSERT INTO auctions (conversation_id, property_id, short_code, expires_at)
  VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    UPPER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') FROM 1 FOR 4)),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  )
  RETURNING auction_id, short_code, expires_at
)
SELECT * FROM new_auction;

SELECT DISTINCT a.agent_id, a.name, a.whatsapp_number
FROM agents a
WHERE (a.on_shift = true AND a.is_available = true)
   OR a.agent_id = $1;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, twilio_sid, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', 'system', $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.conversation_id }},={{ $json.to_phone }},={{ $json.body }},={{ $('Send via Twilio WhatsApp').item.json.sid || null }},={{ JSON.stringify({ purpose: 'auction_notify', auction_id: $json.auction_id, agent_id: $json.agent_id }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE auctions SET notified_agents = $1::text[] WHERE auction_id = $2::uuid;
